notes: PLAYING COUNTS NOW. Time you spend playing anywhere in soundLAB (fretboard and keys drills, Chords, Songs, Jam, Woodshed, the Trainer, or just playing your keyboard or guitar into it) earns 2 XP a minute, and 5 minutes keeps your streak alive, just like finishing a level. Progress shows where your time went. Android Back now steps back through the app (closes the metronome or Settings, leaves a level, returns to the last page) instead of closing it. Exercises: each step opens with its lesson, a wrong answer tells you what you picked, Drill these replays just the questions you missed, and lessons link to the Fretboard, Chords or the Circle to try them for real. Fixed: Keys scale fingering is now correct in every key (no more thumb on black keys in F, B♭, E♭ and the rest), and left-handed taps on the fretboard land on the right fret.
